name: Iron cemetery railing
description: A 1.5 m cemetery fence section: rusted wrought-iron railings of spear-topped bars, two flat rails and a row of rings, set in a low grey stone plinth wall between two square stone piers with pyramid caps; one bar is knocked out of line and rust streaks run down the plinth. Sections join end to end.
